name: currency-transfer
title: Currency Transfer
description: A compact money-transfer tracker: recipient header and status pill, a large amount that rolls from dollars to euros, a four-step rail that fills with ticks, and a copyable reference in the footer.
use: A fintech app shows a single cross-currency transfer moving from paid to arrived.
avoid: Multiple simultaneous transfers: one card tracks one recipient and one amount at a time.
a11y: Strong: a live region announces progress, amounts have text fallbacks and reduced motion is handled. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A small dark card. A round LF avatar with Lena Fischer and a masked bank line sits beside a status pill. A large euro amount dominates above a grey sent and received line. A vertical rail of four step nodes with short details follows, above a footer with the reference and a Rate locked time.
behaves: On load the large amount rolls digit by digit from $500.00 to €460.00 while the rail fills step by step; each finished node draws a tick and the connecting line grows. The status pill crossfades from In progress to Arrived, and the reference copies with a tick.
customise: From and to accounts, rate, reference, timestamp, locale, controlled status and a retry callback are props; timings and colours are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A handful of CSS transitions and keyframes on four steps; no loop beyond the demo run.
demo: Lena Fischer at Deutsche Bank ••7823; 500.00 USD sent, 460.00 EUR received; reference TXN-DAB3UL494.
polishWhy: Careful motion and accessible detail sell the transfer; only the tiny detail text is weak.
